# React Native performance (Callstack)

Callstack's ranked guide to fixing React Native jank, slow startup, big bundles and leaks.

- Source: https://github.com/callstackincubator/agent-skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/callstackincubator/agent-skills/main/skills/react-native-best-practices/SKILL.md
- Author: Callstack
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/react-native-performance-callstack-130364bd

Gives Claude a prioritized playbook for React Native performance: frame rate, time to interactive, bundle size, memory leaks, re-renders and animations. It covers Hermes, JS thread blocking, FlashList, native modules and measuring bundle size before and after changes. A problem-to-fix map points to detailed reference files.

**Try asking:**
- "My React Native list is janky when scrolling, fix it"
- "Reduce our app's startup time"
- "Find the memory leak in this screen"
